seo_description: The rights people search for in Strasbourg and the Eurométropole, and the published places: anonymous signals from the site, not an official measure of non-take-up.
title: Observatory of rights and services
description: Which rights do people search for in Strasbourg and the Eurométropole? Where are published help places missing?
brief.title: In short
brief.1: We count what people search for on the site.
brief.2: We keep no name, no written text, no IP address.
brief.3: We compare these searches with the published help places.
brief.4: Small numbers are hidden to protect people.
caveat.title: Please note
caveat.text: These are signals of use of the site, not a measure of official non-take-up. They are not official statistics. A search is not a person, and most people do not use the site.
closed: The Observatory is not open yet: no figure is published for now.
unavailable: The Observatory cannot be read at the moment. Please try again later.
open_data.title: Download the data
open_data.text: The same figures, without the masked values, are free to reuse under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab). Cite « AccesDirectAide, Observatoire » and the freeze date.
method.title: Method and limits
method.nature: These are signals of use of the AccesDirectAide site, not a measure of official non-take-up. They are not official statistics.
method.count: Each signal counts an event (a search, a choice of situation, a step added), not a person: the same person can produce several, and most people do not use the site.
method.privacy: No text typed, no identifier, no IP address, no time of day is recorded: only a code from a closed list, a day and, for searches, a commune of the Eurométropole (never for a sensitive subject). The daily counts are deleted as soon as the quarter is frozen.
method.situation: The « Ma situation » page sends nothing, unless the person ticks the box to help the Observatory. Only the name of the situation is then sent, nothing else.
method.suppression: A value below 5 (zero included) is « masked »; when only one value is masked in a table, another one is masked too, so that it cannot be found by subtraction; a commune is detailed only for a domain with at least 20 searches in the quarter; totals are sums of published values.
method.supply: The supply counts the reception places published in the site's directory (checked against an official source), sorted by domain according to their type and the services they declare. An unpublished place is not counted; a place can serve several communes and several domains.
method.gaps: A « gap » compares the searches in a domain with the published places of that domain. It is a lead to check on the ground, not an unmet need: the directory is incomplete and a search is not a need.
method.freeze: Only completed calendar quarters are published, once, at their freeze date; they no longer change afterwards.
